title: Machine learning guides new six-colorings of the Euclidean plane
summary: A custom machine-learning approach suggested constructions that authors formalized as two six-colorings. The primary source reports an off-diagonal distance range of 0.354 to 0.657, extending the previously known range. This concerns a specified off-diagonal variant and does not solve the original Hadwiger–Nelson problem.
ai_technology: Custom machine-learning approach; neural networks; differentiable optimization
